name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window card for json-render chats: the commands the model tells the user to run, in order, each with a copy button, and what a command prints when it helps.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   TerminalCard: terminalCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: TerminalCard: ({ props, loading }) => <TerminalCard steps={props.steps} shell={props.shell} cwd={props.cwd} streaming={loading} />

The model writes the commands, so there is no API route and no API key.
